PHY-005.definition_line: ## PHY-005 — dynamic ports and loss characterization

VAL-001.definition_line: | VAL-001 | UNIT | NASA tables and independent tabulated values | scaled cp,h,u,gamma ≤1e-8; EOS inversion ≤1e-8 K |

VAL-002.definition_line: | VAL-002 | NUMERICAL_VERIFICATION | closed moving ideal-gas volume, analytic isentrope, 100–800 cells/steps | finest relative error ≤1e-4; observed order ≥1.8 |

VAL-003.definition_line: | VAL-003 | NUMERICAL_VERIFICATION | closed heat ODE, m=.001 kg, cv=1000, H=2, Tw=600 K, T0=400/800 K | relative error ≤1e-5; order ≥1.8 |

VAL-004.definition_line: | VAL-004 | NUMERICAL_VERIFICATION | ideal nozzle/orifice subcritical and choked references | mass, h0 and choking branch within documented oracle uncertainty and 0.1% total scale |

VAL-005.definition_line: | VAL-005 | NUMERICAL_VERIFICATION | closed UV Wiebe/reaction extent | species/energy ≤1e-10 normalized; exact terminal extent |

VAL-006.definition_line: | VAL-006 | NUMERICAL_VERIFICATION | Sod exact cell averages, N=50…400 | L1 rho at N400 ≤0.004375; decreasing, order ≥0.5 |

VAL-007.definition_line: | VAL-007 | NUMERICAL_VERIFICATION | stationary gamma contact | p,u ≤1e-10 scaled; L1 rho ≤2 dx jump |

VAL-008.definition_line: | VAL-008 | NUMERICAL_VERIFICATION | NASA species/thermal contacts and mixed shocks | operational contact L1≤5e-4, Linf≤5e-3; thermal L1≤2e-3,Linf≤2e-2; positivity/conservation |

VAL-009.definition_line: | VAL-009 | NUMERICAL_VERIFICATION | periodic acoustic Fourier mode | amplitude ≤2(2π/N)^2+10eps; phase ≤π/N; order ≥1.8 |

VAL-010.definition_line: | VAL-010 | NUMERICAL_VERIFICATION | rigid/free reflection, N=800 | wall L1≤0.01; free-end amplitude≤1%, phase≤π/N |

VAL-011.definition_line: | VAL-011 | NUMERICAL_VERIFICATION | variable-area rest and smooth Mthroat=.3 | rest ≤1e-10; L1 rho≤2e-6 at 400; order≥1.8 |

VAL-013.definition_line: | VAL-013 | NUMERICAL_VERIFICATION | fixed reservoir–T3/W2–duct | all primary waveform errors + reference ≤0.1% physical scale; reference ≤0.01%; phase≤4 us; ledger≤1e-10 |

VAL-014.definition_line: | VAL-014 | NUMERICAL_VERIFICATION | moving cylinder–T3/W2–duct | same budgets; p·dV, transferred mass/energy and phase mandatory |

VAL-016.definition_line: | VAL-016 | NUMERICAL_VERIFICATION | original waveform plus additive R1 through 4 ms | same budgets; resolved forward→zero→reverse; donor h0/species and accumulated transfers |

VAL-018.definition_line: | VAL-018 | NUMERICAL_VERIFICATION | source-only and combined heat/shear/K/W2 | analytic/reference error≤0.1%; total-energy ledger≤1e-10; passive entropy |

VAL-020.definition_line: | VAL-020 | NUMERICAL_VERIFICATION | moving crankcase–transfer–cylinder with opening/closing | same 0.1/0.01% and phase budgets; retained passage inventory |

VAL-021.definition_line: | VAL-021 | NUMERICAL_VERIFICATION | complete coupon from cold/warm/high/low composition | NUM-009 thresholds, period 2–8 detection, max-cycle and multiple-attractor semantics |

VAL-022.definition_line: | VAL-022 | EXPERIMENTAL_VALIDATION | Motored cylinder/crankcase campaign, VF-022 and EXR-001/002 | Preregistered 95%/Holm and metrological capability; REQUIRES_EXPERIMENTAL_DATA |

VAL-023.definition_line: | VAL-023 | NUMERICAL_VERIFICATION | reaction source limits | no depleted reactant; exact coordinate/species/energy ledgers |

VAL-024.definition_line: | VAL-024 | NUMERICAL_VERIFICATION | distributed/local loss | sign/passivity/analytic laminar limit and map station semantics |

VAL-025.definition_line: | VAL-025 | EXPERIMENTAL_VALIDATION | complete reference engine calibration/validation split | GUM uncertainty, preregistered observables; calibration allowed only on calibration partition |

VAL-026.definition_line: | VAL-026 | EXPERIMENTAL_VALIDATION | held-out rpm/load/phi/exhaust points | no recalibration; preregistered 95% acceptance and multiplicity control |

VAL-027.definition_line: | VAL-027 | NUMERICAL_VERIFICATION | smooth MOL entropy wave, independent DOP853 | dt=.002…2.5e-4, finest L1≤1e-10, order 1.8–2.2 |

VAL-028.definition_line: | VAL-028 | NUMERICAL_VERIFICATION | exact two-zone mixing/birth/merge/re-entry | relative error≤1e-6, order≥1.8, ledger≤1e-10 |
